en: Dependent on a state fixed in falsehood by way of cause, a state fixed in falsehood arises by way of the root-condition.
Dependent on a state fixed in falsehood by way of cause, a state not fixed in rightness arises by way of the root-condition. [Dependent on] a state fixed in falsehood...
Dependent on a state that is not fixed [in either wrongness or rightness], a state that is not fixed arises by way of root condition.
Dependent on a state fixed in wrongness, states that are neither fixed in rightness nor fixed arise by way of root condition.
Dependent on a state fixed in wrongness, states that are neither fixed in wrongness nor fixed in rightness arise by way of root condition.
Dependent on a state fixed in rightness, a state not fixed in rightness arises by way of root-condition.
Dependent on a state fixed in rightness, a state not fixed in wrongness arises by way of root-condition.
Dependent on a state fixed in rightness, a state not fixed [in either] arises by way of root-condition. Dependent on a state fixed in rightness, a state not fixed in wrongness...

And dependent on a state that is neither fixed, states that are neither fixed-nor-erroneous and neither fixed-nor-right arise by way of root condition. Dependent on a state that is fixed in the right direction, states that are neither fixed-in-erroneousness nor fixed-in-the-right-direction arise by way of root condition.
Dependent on a state that is not fixed, a state that is neither fixed-in-erroneousness arises by way of root condition… three.
Dependent on states that are both fixed in the wrongness and undetermined, a state fixed in the wrongness arises by way of root condition … three.

Dependent on states that are both fixed in the rightness and undetermined, a state fixed in the wrongness arises by way of root condition … three. (Abbreviated. Under root [condition] there are nineteen;
under object [condition], nine … pe … under resultant [condition], three … pe … under non-disappearance [condition], nineteen. (To be expanded in all cases.)
